pages.text: Unconfined aether is light you cannot hold for long. It fades after about 100 ticks; the countdown while holding it shows the time left. Its tooltip records the actual contents, usually 200 aether.

pages.title: Do not let it fade unused
pages.text: Prepare your recipe before extracting from a disruptor or condenser. Finished devices confine aether and do not keep counting down.$(br2)If you cannot use a fragment in time, return it to a finite reservoir with room before it fades. For lasting material, seek a crystallization chamber.
